test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 24 men can do a work in 15 days by working 12 hours daily, then in how many days will 36 men be able to do double the quantum of work, by working 10 hours daily?
solution:
**Given:**

24 men can do work in 15 days by working 12 hours daily

**Concept used:**

M₁ × T₁ × D₁/W₁ = M₂ × T₂ × D₂/W₂

**Calculation:**

According to the concept,

2 × (24 × 15 × 12) = (36 × 10 × D₂)

⇒ D2 = 8640/360 = 24

**∴ Required time is 24 days**
